_comment: Advisories CI's npm audit accepts (ops/ci/npm-audit-check.py). Each needs a reason it doesn't apply here and a review_by date; past that date the audit fails until someone looks again. Remove an entry once a fix ships.

allow.reason: Open redirect via a backslash in <Link> and useNavigate. Fixed only in 7.18 (no 6.x release); the SPA is on 6.30. The one navigation target a user controls is ?next= on the sign-in page, and login.tsx localPath() refuses anything that isn't a same-origin path or contains a backslash or control character. Upgrade to v7 is the fix.

Constructor injection through deserializeErrors() during server-side rendering hydration. The SPA renders only in the browser with <BrowserRouter> (main.tsx): no SSR, no data router, no hydrationData, so the code path never runs. Upgrade to v7 is the fix.
